-- Initial schema
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS i18n (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    language char(2) UNIQUE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tag (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    name varchar(255),
    slug varchar(255) UNIQUE,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    slug varchar(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    current_version_id uuid NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_version (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version int NOT NULL,
    status smallint NOT NULL,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    tech_label varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    main_tech varchar(64),
    main_tech_version varchar(32),
    is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_deprecated boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamptz NULL,
    UNIQUE(course_id, version)
);

ALTER TABLE course ADD CONSTRAINT fk_course_current_version FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id) REFERENCES course_version(id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_version_i18n (
    course_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_version_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_tag (
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tag(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (course_id, tag_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    course_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_i18n (
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (lesson_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_tag (
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tag(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (lesson_id, tag_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS code_structure_type (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    code varchar(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NULL,
    validator_service varchar(255) NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    course_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES course_version(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    code_structure_type_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES code_structure_type(id),
    code_structure jsonb NOT NULL,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    version int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    max_attempts int NULL,
    deadline_at timestamptz NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_i18n (
    task_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (task_id, i18n_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_filestorage (
    task_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    type smallint NOT NULL,
    filestorage_id uuid NOT NULL,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (task_id, type, filestorage_id)
);
